pages.title: Red Deer
pages.text: The red deer ($(o)Cervus elaphus$()) is a large deer native to Europe, western Asia and the Atlas Mountains of north-west Africa.$(br2)Stags grow branching antlers and roar loudly during the autumn rut, competing to gather and defend groups of hinds.$(br2)Red deer live in woodland, moorland and mountain habitats, and outside the breeding season males and females usually live in separate herds.
